name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 3.89 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
